A '''stormtrooper''' [[Stormtrooper Commander|officer]] served on an [[Unidentified astronomical object (Cort)|astronomical object]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. He and his unit looked for a young Jedi named [[Lyco Strata]] who hid in [[Cort]]'s shop. The stormtroopers entered and ordered Cort and [[Asajj Ventress]] to provide credentials as well as to submit to a search of their workplace. Ventress used a [[mind trick]] to convince them to search somewhere else, but Cort revealed the hiding Jedi for a reward. Ventress then killed the stormtroopers and escaped from the travel shop with Lyco.<ref name="Way" />
